stories.title: Adopt Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract (Align with Brain)
stories.description: Align debug_logger output to a standardized audit schema (timestamp, actor, action_type, tool_name, payload metadata, correlation_id, previous_hash, current_hash) and define an explicit append-only contract including MongoDB collection rules (insert-only, no update/delete paths, write-once semantics enforced at repository layer).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; ASSUMPTION: Brain audit schema standard exists; GAP: formal schema mapping spec

stories.title: Append-Only Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Implement core audit logging engine that produces immutable records with deterministic hash chaining (previous_hash → current_hash), ensures ordering guarantees, and enforces insert-only writes via a dedicated persistence abstraction.

stories.title: Audit Instrumentation Across Tooling and Services
stories.description: Instrument tool_router, safety_service, provider_search_service, and clinical_trials_service to emit structured audit events for tool calls, external API usage, and safety triggers, ensuring consistent propagation of correlation_id across the full request lifecycle.

stories.title: Internal Audit Log Read API with Integrity Verification
stories.description: Implement backend-only read/query interface for audit logs supporting filters (correlation_id, time range, action_type) and optional full-chain hash verification to validate integrity; explicitly restrict from external/public exposure.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing read/query interface in debug_logger

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection
stories.description: Extend test_debug_logger to validate append-only enforcement, hash chain continuity, cross-service event coverage, and tamper detection scenarios (altered, deleted, or reordered records), including integration tests from tool_router through persistence.

stories.title: Dedicated Audit Log Collection and Access Isolation
stories.description: Provision a dedicated MongoDB collection for audit logs with restricted access patterns (write via logger only, read via controlled API only), and enforce role-based access at the infrastructure layer to prevent accidental mutation or cross-service misuse.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; ASSUMPTION: MongoDB is primary persistence; GAP: explicit collection isolation policy not defined
